cohort.raw_archive_reverification: not performed here; prepared waveform bytes matched the running LLM's frozen artifact ledger

subject_cluster_uncertainty.method: paired participant-cluster percentile bootstrap; equal participant resampling, all sampled participant windows retained
subject_cluster_uncertainty.limits: Conditional uncertainty of these fitted models on an enriched held-out sample with only 8 subjects; not natural-population precision, training-repeat uncertainty, multiplicity-adjusted evidence, or a continuous-use false-action rate.

history_feature_scope: Only frozen past-event counts, capped recency, source/missing indicators; source manifest SHA authenticated, source TSV histories not independently reconstructed by this baseline.
imputation: Deterministic capped lag=60 plus missing indicator; no test-derived statistics; train-only scaling and context vocabulary.
cohort_scope: Enriched case-control, observed agent request transmission versus other observed actions. No idle labels. No latent-intent gold.
